description: Builds a Qt application with make after detecting QTDIR.
name: qt-make-build
promptTemplate:
Run the complete Bash script with `shell_call` using its `command` parameter (example: `{ "command": "<complete Bash script>", "shell": "/bin/bash" }`). First check runtime availability with `shell_call` and `command -v node || true; command -v python3 || true`. Use `shell_call` for these native build and compiler commands. For a Node.js helper, use `nodejs_runtime` with `{ "inlineScript": "...", "workingDirectory": "...", "timeoutSeconds": 60 }`; for Python use `python_runtime` with `{ "inlineScript": "...", "workingDirectory": "...", "timeoutSeconds": 60 }`. Use `{{project_directory}}` as the directory containing the Makefile. QTDIR must be detected before make runs.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
PROJECT_DIR="{{project_directory}}"
[ -n "$PROJECT_DIR" ] && [ "$PROJECT_DIR" != "{{project_directory}}" ] || { echo "Missing project_directory" >&2; exit 1; }
find_qmake() {
  if [ -n "${QTDIR:-}" ] && [ -x "$QTDIR/bin/qmake" ]; then echo "$QTDIR/bin/qmake"; return 0; fi
  if command -v qmake >/dev/null 2>&1; then command -v qmake; return 0; fi
  if command -v qmake6 >/dev/null 2>&1; then command -v qmake6; return 0; fi
  for q in "$HOME"/Qt/*/macos/bin/qmake "$HOME"/Qt/*/clang_64/bin/qmake /Applications/Qt/*/macos/bin/qmake /opt/homebrew/opt/qt/bin/qmake /usr/local/opt/qt/bin/qmake; do [ -x "$q" ] && echo "$q" && return 0; done
  return 1
}
QMAKE_BIN="$(find_qmake)" || { echo "qmake not found. Install Qt or set QTDIR." >&2; exit 1; }
export QTDIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$QMAKE_BIN")/.." && pwd)"
export PATH="$QTDIR/bin:$PATH"
cd "$PROJECT_DIR"
[ -f Makefile ] || { echo "Makefile not found in $PROJECT_DIR" >&2; exit 1; }
make -j"$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null || echo 4)"
```

Return the make output and detected QTDIR.
systemInstruction: Use make for the Qt app build and detect QTDIR before the build.
